sentences.text: Mira refused every z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row (34 of 38 rated feedings refused, 4 partly eaten), and the owner stopped the trial on day 19 of 42.
Her total intake is unknown: intake not directly observed, as a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down and she lives with 1 other cat.
Over the same 18 days her weight went from 4.4 to 4.1 kg, −6.8% on 2 home-scale readings, and in cats 48 to 72 hours of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window.
Vomiting was logged on 5 of 19 logged days, and nothing logged after Jun 19, 13 days before this report.
